Title: C# and .NET foundations
Why: A grounded start: the language, the runtime and the tooling you will use every day.

Steps.Text: Install the .NET SDK and build a console app with the dotnet CLI.
Work through the C# tour: types, control flow, classes and records.
Learn LINQ by rewriting loops as queries.

Title: Build a web API with ASP.NET Core
Why: Minimal APIs, dependency injection and middleware are the backbone of every ASP.NET Core service.

Steps.Text: Build a minimal API with a few endpoints.
Understand the request pipeline and write a small middleware.
Add EF Core with migrations and a real database.

Title: Fast, correct, production-ready
Why: Async, memory and measurement separate code that works from code that holds up under load.

Steps.Text: Understand garbage collection and how to allocate less.
Benchmark a hot path with BenchmarkDotNet.
